name: crewforge5
description: Seven commands over one repo: /crewforge5:init audits and slims your Claude config, /crewforge5:crew forges a validated agent crew for your stack, /crewforge5:plan, /crewforge5:design and /crewforge5:build turn a goal into human-accepted intent, spec and test-first plan, /crewforge5:review checks and reviews the implementation, and /crewforge5:execute is the shortcut that runs build then review on an accepted plan (with --teams, the graph-mode agent-team sprint).
